· 52주 위치(4.2%) + 현 가격대 역사적 저점 부근 위치
[모멘텀 지표]

[지지·저항 구조]
· 스윙 지지선 ($0.05): 52주 저가 및 볼린저 하단 기반
· 스윙 저항선 ($0.07): SMA50 및 피벗 R1 기반
· 5일/20일 고가·저가 패턴 (Higher Low 확인): 바닥 다지기 신호
[거래량·결론]

· 현 구간 진단 (축적구간): RSI 과매도 지속 및 거래량 위축으로 관망 유지 조건
analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($0.06) above SMA5/20 ($0.06/$0.06), below SMA50 ($0.07): indicating short-term strength and a mid-term trend reversal phase.
· Below SMA100/200 ($0.08/$0.08): confirming a weak mid-to-long-term trend.
· 52-week position (4.2%) + current price level near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI 27.8 → 27.3 (continuing in oversold territory): maintaining bearish momentum.
· MACD histogram -0.0007 → -0.0003 (improving): suggesting a potential weakening of bearish pressure.
· Bollinger Band current price ($0.06) near the lower band ($0.05): confirming downside resilience.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support at $0.05: based on 52-week low and lower Bollinger Band.
· Swing resistance at $0.07: based on SMA50 and Pivot R1.
· 5-day/20-day price pattern (Higher Low confirmed): signaling bottoming action.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.65x): indicating subdued confidence in price movements.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation): maintaining a wait-and-see approach due to persistent oversold RSI and low volume.
